limitations: Only the stated straight-alphabet Progressive Key variant and declared periods/progressions are tested.
Condi covers only the20explicit keyword guesses and settings, not all alphabets or keywords.
Pure transposition portfolio excludes nonrectangular columnar/route layouts, unknown padding, nulls and arbitrary column permutations.
No combined substitution/transposition layers or clock-derived keys are tested.
Progressive partial key slots can make withheld letters untestable; they are not positive recovery evidence.
The reciprocal public-crib check is withheld from fitting, not secret independently discovered plaintext.
Even a full heldout match would need additional independent archival plaintext/key evidence before a historical solution claim.
